summary: 2026-27 home kit: the chest carries only the club crest; FONBET wordmark on the lower front and both sleeves, Gazprom Neft's orange G-brand on the shoulders, G-ENERGY on the back hem and pants, Alfa-Bank patch on the pants (club kit-launch photos, 9 August 2026). A white decal on the helmets is illegible, and the potential kit-manufacturer mark is unconfirmed, so the sponsor list is not certain to be complete.
